job_description: Purchase Management: Manage and coordinate the procurement of all medical, non-medical, general, engineering, housekeeping, office, IT, maintenance and other required materials to ensure uninterrupted hospital operations. Procurement Planning: Prepare and implement procurement plans based on departmental requirements, stock positions, consumption trends, budget allocations and operational priorities. Purchase Requisition Management: Receive, review and verify departmental Purchase Requisitions (PRs) to ensure proper specifications, quantities, justification, budget availability and approval before initiating procurement. Supplier Sourcing & Development: Identify, evaluate and develop reliable suppliers, manufacturers, distributors and service providers to ensure quality products, competitive prices and timely delivery. Quotation Collection: Collect quotations from multiple suppliers, prepare comparative statements and evaluate offers based on price, quality, brand, specification, warranty, delivery schedule and payment terms. Price Negotiation: Negotiate with suppliers to obtain the best possible prices, discounts, credit facilities, payment terms, warranty and other commercial benefits while maintaining quality standards.  Purchase Order Preparation: Ensure accurate preparation and timely issuance of Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with approved requisitions, quotations, comparative statements and management approvals. Purchase Approval & Compliance: Ensure all procurement activities follow the hospital`s approved procurement policy, financial authority matrix, budgetary controls and management instructions. Medical Equipment Procurement: Coordinate procurement of medical equipment, surgical instruments, diagnostic devices, ICU/CCU equipment, OT equipment, spare parts and other specialized healthcare products in consultation with concerned technical departments. Pharmaceutical & Medical Consumables Procurement: Coordinate the procurement of medical consumables, surgical items, disposables, laboratory supplies and other healthcare-related materials in accordance with approved specifications and quality requirements. Non-Medical Procurement: Manage the procurement of office supplies, stationery, furniture, IT accessories, uniforms, housekeeping materials, cleaning supplies, electrical items, plumbing materials and other general requirements. Engineering & Maintenance Procurement: Coordinate with Engineering & Maintenance to procure electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, civil, generator, lift, medical gas system and other maintenance-related materials and spare parts. Supplier Performance Monitoring: Regularly monitor supplier performance regarding product quality, pricing, delivery commitments, after-sales service, warranty support and contractual obligations. Delivery Follow-up: Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of ordered materials and take immediate action in case of delays, partial deliveries or failure to meet commitments. Emergency Procurement: Arrange urgent procurement of critical medical supplies, equipment, spare parts and other essential materials required by ICU, CCU, OT, Emergency, Laboratory, Pharmacy and other departments without compromising approval and documentation procedures. Market Price Monitoring: Regularly monitor market prices, supplier rates, product availability and market trends to identify cost-saving opportunities and ensure competitive procurement. Quality & Specification Verification: Coordinate with concerned departments, technical experts and Store personnel to ensure that procured items meet approved specifications, quality standards, brand requirements and applicable regulatory requirements. Import Procurement Coordination: Coordinate with suppliers, importers, clearing and forwarding agents and other relevant parties for imported medical equipment, spare parts and specialized materials, including delivery and documentation follow-up. Contract & Agreement Management: Maintain and monitor supplier agreements, rate contracts, annual procurement contracts, warranty documents, service agreements and other commercial commitments. Purchase Budget Control: Monitor procurement expenditure against approved budgets and ensure economical purchasing without compromising patient care, service quality and hospital operations. Cost Control & Savings: Identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs through bulk purchasing, competitive bidding, supplier negotiations, alternative sourcing and improved procurement planning. Purchase Documentation: Ensure proper preparation and maintenance of Purchase Requisitions, Quotations, Comparative Statements, Purchase Orders, Work Orders, Agreements, Delivery Challans, Invoices and other relevant procurement documents. Bill Verification & Payment Coordination: Verify supplier invoices against approved Purchase Orders, delivery documents, Store Receiving Reports/MRR/GRN and agreed commercial terms before forwarding bills to Accounts & Finance for payment processing. Pending Order Monitoring: Maintain an updated record of pending Purchase Orders, partially supplied items, delayed deliveries, outstanding supplier commitments and payment-related issues, and take necessary follow-up actions. Supplier Payment Coordination: Coordinate with Accounts & Finance regarding supplier bills, payment schedules, advance payments, credit facilities, outstanding balances and other financial matters. Procurement Record Maintenance: Maintain accurate and updated records of suppliers, quotations, price comparisons, Purchase Orders, procurement history, product specifications and supplier performance in ERP/software and other approved records. ERP & Software Management: Ensure all procurement transactions, requisitions, approvals, Purchase Orders and supplier-related information are accurately recorded and updated in the hospital`s ERP/software system. Departmental Coordination: Maintain effective coordination with Store, Accounts & Finance, Administration, Pharmacy, OT, ICU, CCU, Emergency, Laboratory, Engineering & Maintenance, Housekeeping, IT and other departments to identify requirements and ensure timely procurement. Purchase & Store Coordination: Maintain close coordination with the Store Department regarding stock availability, minimum and maximum stock levels, reorder levels, slow-moving items, near-expiry items and urgent replenishment requirements to avoid unnecessary purchasing and stock-outs. Supplier Relationship Management: Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and ensure transparency, fairness, accountability and ethical practices throughout the procurement process. Return & Replacement Management: Coordinate with suppliers for replacement, repair, warranty claims, credit notes or return of defective, damaged, incorrect or non-compliant materials. Disposal & Replacement Coordination: Coordinate with relevant departments and Store regarding obsolete, unusable, damaged and outdated materials requiring replacement or disposal, ensuring appropriate approvals and documentation. Reporting to Management: Prepare and submit Daily, Weekly and Monthly Purchase Reports covering procurement status, total purchase value, pending requisitions, pending Purchase Orders, supplier performance, cost savings, emergency purchases, delayed deliveries and outstanding bills. Audit & Compliance: Ensure all procurement records are properly maintained and readily available for internal and external audits. Identify and address discrepancies, documentation gaps and non-compliance issues. Risk Management: Identify procurement risks relating to supplier dependency, market price fluctuations, product shortages, delivery delays, quality issues and supply chain disruptions, and take preventive measures. Team Supervision & Accountability: Supervise Purchase Officers, Executives and support staff; distribute responsibilities, monitor performance, maintain discipline and ensure that all procurement activities are completed accurately, efficiently and transparently. Confidentiality & Ethical Procurement: Maintain confidentiality of quotations, supplier pricing, commercial information and procurement decisions. Prevent conflicts of interest, unauthorized purchasing, favoritism and unethical supplier dealings. Other Responsibilities: Perform any other purchase-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the Manager, Head of SCM, Administration or Hospital Management in the interest of smooth hospital operations

job_description: Position Purpose To manage and supervise the overall Finishing operations of Jamuna Paper Mills Ltd., ensuring efficient, accurate, and quality-oriented finishing of  Duplex Board, Liner, Media, Kraft Paper, and Simplex Paper.  The position will be responsible for managing rewinding, cutting, sheeting, ream wrapping, packaging and dispatch preparation activities. The role will ensure finished product quality, dimensional accuracy, optimum machine utilization, minimum wastage, timely order fulfillment and effective coordination with Production, Quality Control, Warehouse and Dispatch departments while maintaining workplace safety and operational efficiency. Duties & Responsibilities Plan, organize and supervise daily finishing operations to achieve production targets and meet customer delivery schedules. Manage and monitor finishing operations of  Duplex Board, Liner, Media, Kraft  and  Simplex Paper  to ensure efficient and consistent product finishing. Supervise the operation of rewinding, sheeting, cutting, trimming, ream wrapping, packaging, and other finishing equipment. Ensure finished paper and board products meet customer specifications regarding GSM, width, length, thickness, moisture, edge quality, roll diameter and other quality parameters. Ensure accurate slitting, rewinding, cutting and sheeting according to approved production plans and customer requirements. Monitor finishing machine performance, production speed, efficiency, downtime and operational losses and take necessary corrective actions. Ensure proper utilization of finishing machines and manpower to achieve maximum productivity and optimum operational efficiency. Minimize paper wastage, trim loss, rejected products, packaging material consumption, and other finishing-related production costs. Ensure proper roll identification, labeling, weighing, counting, and product traceability throughout the finishing process. Monitor and maintain the quality of finished rolls, sheets, reams and packaged products in accordance with established quality standards. Coordinate with Production and Quality Control teams to identify and resolve finishing-related quality problems, customer complaints, and product rejection issues. Ensure proper packaging, wrapping, strapping, palletizing, and storage of finished products to prevent damage during handling, transportation and delivery. job_description: Position Purpose To lead and manage the overall Mechanical Maintenance and Engineering operations of Jamuna Paper Mills Ltd., ensuring reliable, efficient and uninterrupted operation of all mechanical systems, machinery, and equipment associated with  Duplex Board, Liner, Media, Kraft, and Simplex paper machines.  The position will be responsible for ensuring maximum machine availability, minimizing mechanical breakdowns and production downtime, implementing preventive and predictive maintenance programs, optimizing maintenance costs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational safety, and improving overall plant efficiency and productivity. Duties & Responsibilities Lead, supervise and manage all mechanical maintenance and engineering operations of the paper mill to ensure uninterrupted production activities. Ensure smooth operation, maintenance, trouble shooting and performance optimization of mechanical systems associated with  Duplex Board, Liner, Media, Kraft and Simplex paper machines. Oversee the installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of paper machines, mechanical equipment and associated production facilities. Develop and implement preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance plans to minimize equipment failures and unplanned production downtime. Lead mechanical troubleshooting activities and ensure timely resolution of technical problems affecting production operations. Ensure proper maintenance and reliable operation of paper machine components, including head boxes, forming sections, press sections, dryer sections, calendars, winders, pulpers, refiners, pumps, agitators, rollers, bearings, gears, couplings and transmission systems. Monitor machine performance, vibration, alignment, lubrication, temperature, and other critical mechanical parameters to ensure equipment reliability and operational efficiency. Ensure proper maintenance and efficient operation of utility equipment, including boilers, pumps, compressors, cooling towers, water treatment systems, pipelines, and other mechanical installations. Coordinate with Production, Electrical & Instrumentation, Utility, Supply Chain, and other relevant departments to ensure maximum machine availability and uninterrupted production. Ensure proper maintenance of mechanical drawings, equipment specifications, maintenance schedules, equipment history, and technical documentation. Monitor critical mechanical spare parts inventory and ensure timely availability of essential components to minimize equipment downtime. Lead, supervise, and develop the mechanical maintenance team, including engineers, supervisors, technicians, fitters, welders, and other technical personnel. Prepare regular reports on machine performance, mechanical breakdowns, maintenance activities, downtime, spare parts consumption, and maintenance costs for senior management.
